title: Say So
lyrics: To be [C#m]salt and light in the world, in the world, to be [D]salt and light in the world!
To be [F#m7]salt and light in the world, in the world, to be [D]salt and light in the world!
To be [C#m]salt and light in the world, in the world,
In the [D]world, in the world, in the world!
Let the re[E]deemed of the Lord rise up, Let the re[Bm7]deemed of the Lord rise up,
Let the re[A]deemed of the Lord rise[Dmaj7] up, rise up, [E]rise up!
Let the re[E]deemed of the Lord say so, Let the re[Bm7]deemed of the Lord say so,
Let the re[A]deemed of the Lord say[Dmaj7] so, say so, [E]say so!
[Esus]I    [E]am redeemed, [Esus]I    [E]am redeemed, [D]I am redeemed, [D]I am redeemed
[A/C#]I am redeemed, [D]I am redeemed [E] (these two lines 2x)
Let the re[E]deemed of the Lord say so, Let the re[Bm7]deemed of the Lord say so,
Let the re[A]deemed of the Lord say[Dmaj7] so, say so, [E]say so, say so, say so!
